shadowing.intro: Shadow YouTube videos: loop each sentence, speak over it, compare with your recording.
shadowing.paste_hint: Paste a YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, shorts). The app creates a lesson; then paste the transcript to split it into sentences.
shadowing.bad_link: This does not look like a YouTube link.
shadowing.mine_empty: No videos yet. Paste a YouTube link above to start.
shadowing.no_segments_title: This video has no sentences yet
shadowing.no_segments_hint: Fastest: on YouTube open "Show transcript" (under the description), copy it all and paste it here. Or mark the start/end of each sentence while watching.
shadowing.paste_step1: Open the video on YouTube, click "…more" in the description, then "Show transcript".
shadowing.paste_step2: Select the whole transcript and copy it (Ctrl+C). .srt / .vtt subtitles also work.
shadowing.paste_step3: Paste it below: the app splits sentences by timestamp and adds pinyin.
shadowing.replace_warning: The lesson’s current sentences will be replaced.
shadowing.headphones_tip: Tip: wear headphones when shadowing so the mic only hears you. Recordings stay on this device.
shadowing.mark_hint: Play the video, press "Mark start" when a sentence begins and "End sentence" when it ends, then type its words.
shadowing.keys_hint: Shortcuts: Space play/pause · ← → previous/next sentence · Esc exit zoom. Click a sentence to hear it from the start.
